name: Annual Performance Review
description: Comprehensive yearly performance assessment template covering goal achievement, competency demonstration, and self-reflection. Used company-wide for the annual fiscal-year review cycle. Currently in version 3, refined from feedback collected during the FY2025 cycle.
audienceDescription: All full-time employees with at least 90 days of tenure at the time of cycle launch. Includes engineers, product managers, customer success, and operations roles. Excludes contractors and interns.

sections.name: Goals
sections.description: Reviews progress against the goals committed at the beginning of the cycle. Each goal is rated on its own merit and aggregated into the section score.

questions.prompt: Describe progress against your top business goal for the cycle.
questions.helpText: Aim for 200-400 words. Include specific outcomes and metrics where possible.

questions.prompt: Rate your overall achievement against committed goals.
Which goal did you exceed expectations on, and how?
questions.helpText: Optional. Describe one specific goal where you exceeded expectations.

questions.prompt: Which goal fell short, and what did you learn?
questions.helpText: Optional. Frame as a learning rather than a failure.

questions.prompt: How well did your goals align with team and organizational priorities?

sections.name: Competencies
sections.description: Assesses demonstration of the company's core competencies during the review cycle. Each competency is rated using the universal Whoville proficiency scale and accompanied by behavioral examples.

questions.prompt: Rate your demonstrated proficiency in TypeScript over the cycle.
Rate your demonstrated proficiency in System Design over the cycle.
Rate your demonstrated proficiency in Code Review over the cycle.
Rate your demonstrated proficiency in Stakeholder Management over the cycle.
Rate your demonstrated proficiency in Cross-Functional Collaboration over the cycle.
Rate your demonstrated proficiency in Mentoring over the cycle.
Provide one concrete example of competency demonstration from the cycle.
questions.helpText: Choose a single moment that demonstrates one of the rated competencies above.

questions.prompt: Which competency do you most want to develop next cycle?

sections.name: Self-Reflection
sections.description: Open-ended reflection on the cycle, capturing growth, challenges, and forward-looking commitments. Less structured than Goals or Competencies but equally important for development conversations.

questions.prompt: What was your most significant growth area during this cycle?
What was the most significant challenge you faced, and how did you respond?
What support do you need from your manager for next cycle?
questions.helpText: Be specific. Examples: more frequent 1:1s, exposure to a particular project, learning budget.

questions.prompt: Rate your overall job satisfaction this cycle.

history.summary: Template created for FY2024 annual review cycle.
Version 2 published with refined competencies section based on FY2024 feedback.
Version 3 published with new self-reflection section and updated competency mapping.
Help text refined on three goal questions for clarity.
